adjudication.family_description: A supplier bill paid by company card with an emailed receipt; the supplier later refunds the card, fully or in part, on the same authorisation.

adjudication.label_reason: The receipt binds the card charge to the bill and the supplier refunds the full amount to the same card authorisation two days later: the charge settles nothing.
adjudication.terminal_reason: A full refund on the same instrument is a mechanical reversal; the evidence is complete.
